$comment: Regulator adapters (Phase 5, differentiator C). Matching (src/lib/regulators/match.ts): a ruling is scored only when one of the ruled entity's names (the advertiser field, split on 't/a' / 'trading as') equals the brand after normalisation, with legal suffixes (config/wikidata.json legalSuffixes) and the geographic or structural qualifiers below removed. A whole-word occurrence of the brand anywhere else in the title or advertiser is a 'possible' match: shown, never scored. maxRulings bounds the ruling pages fetched per adapter and run. ADR-033 (Phase 14): a ruling naming the brand is scored as regulator.ruling only when its topic is environmental: the regulator's own topic line when published, else a whole-word match of environmentalTopic.terms (a trailing * matches any word ending; EN and FR) against the ruling title and fetched text (src/lib/regulators/topic.ts). Otherwise it is listed as regulator.ruling_other_topic (0 points).
